missingSafetyStop.evidence: Stop using the microwave now: switch it off at the socket and unplug it

rationale: The assistant gave an excellent immediate stop-use and unplug instruction, warned against opening the casing, and correctly identified the waveguide cover as a likely cause. It never asked the customer to inspect the cover or confirm there was no metal, and it jumped straight to an engineer instead of the cheap waveguide cover replacement and cavity clean. It also said the fault 'can damage the magnetron', which is a mild overreach, and it repeated the casing warning, so it was safe but not very useful for a DIY-capable customer.
